coverage_limitations: No third-party FLOP/MAC profiler (fvcore/thop/ptflops/torchinfo) is installed. Phase34 will NOT install one. Profiler-reported FLOPs are therefore unavailable; the historical analytical Conv2d/Linear MAC lower bound plus parameter counts and measured runtime/memory remain the Phase34 evidence base.
mixing_rule: PROFILER_REPORTED_FLOPS and ANALYTICAL MAC LOWER BOUND must never share one numeric column without explicit type labeling.
